Prealgebra · Lesson 9.3

Percent Increase and Decrease

Solve this lesson →All lessons

In 9.2 you took a percent of a fixed number. Here the number changes and you want the new amount. A 30%30% rise makes the new amount 130%130% of the original, one multiply by 1.301.30. That number is the multiplier. A drop of 20%20% leaves 80%80%, a multiplier of 0.800.80.

Problem
A garden trail of 240240 m was extended by 35%35%. Find 35%35% of 240240, then add it to 240240. How many meters of trail are there now?
Show a hint
  • The extra trail is 35%35% of the ORIGINAL 240240 meters, not of some new total. Use part == percent ×× whole, so the added length is 0.35×2400.35×240.
  • Once you know the added piece is 8484 meters, the new trail is just the old length plus that piece, 240+84240+84. Adding the extra back on is what makes this an increase.
Show the full solution
35%35% of 240240 is 0.35×240=840.35×240=84 meters of new trail, and 240+84=324240+84=324. The trail is now 324324​ meters. Faster route, keeping the original and adding 35%35% more is 135%135%, so 240×1.35=324240×1.35=324 in one step.
Problem
A streaming channel had 480480 subscribers and grew by 35%35%. The new count is 135%135% of 480480. How many subscribers does the channel have now?
Show a hint
  • The original count is 100%100% of itself, and an increase piles more on top of that. A 35%35% increase means the new amount is 100%+35%=135%100%+35%=135% of the original.
  • Turn 135%135% into the multiplier 1.351.35, then compute 480×1.35480×1.35 in one step instead of adding the part separately.
Show the full solution
The new count is 100%+35%=135%100%+35%=135% of 480480, a multiplier of 1.351.35. 480×1.35=648480×1.35=648 The channel now has 648648​ subscribers. Adding the part separately gives the same thing, since 0.35×480=1680.35×480=168 and 480+168=648480+168=648.
Key idea
Increase multiplier. A p%p% rise adds p%p% of the starting amount onto that starting amount. The original is already the full 100%100%, so rising by p%p% brings you to (100+p)%(100+p)% of the start. You can get there in one step by multiplying by 1+p1001+100p​. A 30%30% rise is a single multiplication by 1.301.30.
Problem
A coastal marsh had 350350 wading birds at dawn. By midday, 12%12% had flown off. The survivors are 88%88% of 350350. How many birds remain at midday?
Show a hint
  • A 12%12% decrease does not leave 12%12%. It leaves the rest. Find the leftover percent by taking 100%−12%=88%100%−12%=88%, and that fraction of the flock is what you want.
  • Turn 88%88% into the multiplier 0.880.88 and multiply the original count by it, 350×0.88350×0.88. If you prefer the long way, take 12%12% of 350350 and subtract it from 350350. Both roads land on the same number.
Show the full solution
A 12%12% drop leaves 100%−12%=88%100%−12%=88%, so the multiplier is 0.880.88. 350×0.88=308350×0.88=308 At midday there are 308308​ birds. The long way agrees, since 0.12×350=420.12×350=42 birds flew off and 350−42=308350−42=308.
Problem
A kayak rental costs $90$90 a day. A 40%40% discount removes 40%40% and leaves 60%60%. What is the discounted price in dollars?
Show a hint
  • A 40%40% discount removes 40%40% of the price, so what is left is 100%−40%=60%100%−40%=60% of it. That surviving 60%60% is your multiplier.
  • The multiplier for a 40%40% decrease is 1−0.40=0.601−0.40=0.60. Multiply the original price by it, 90×0.6090×0.60.
Show the full solution
A 40%40% discount leaves 100%−40%=60%100%−40%=60% of the price, so the multiplier is 0.600.60. 90×0.60=5490×0.60=54 The discounted price is 5454​ dollars. The multiplier folds the subtracting into one step, since 0.40×90=360.40×90=36 and 90−36=5490−36=54.
Key idea
Decrease multiplier. Cutting p%p% off leaves the rest of the 100%100%, so a p%p% decrease multiplies by 1−p1001−100p​. Removing 12%12% leaves 88%88%, a single multiplication by 0.880.88. A 20%20% discount is 80%80% of the price. An increase puts the multiplier above 11, and a decrease puts it below 11.
Problem
A podcast went from 250250 plays to 320320. The change is 7070 plays. Divide by the original 250250, not the new 320320. What percent increase was this? Give the number only.
Show a hint
  • First find the change in plays, the new amount minus the old amount. Then remember a percent change is measured against the ORIGINAL, so the comparison you want is that change divided by 250250, not divided by 320320.
  • You have 7070 more plays out of the starting 250250. Compute 7025025070​ and turn that fraction into a percent by multiplying by 100100.
Show the full solution
The change is 320−250=70320−250=70 plays, and a percent change divides by the original. 70250×100=2825070​×100=28 The increase is 2828​. Forward check, a 28%28% rise scales by 1.281.28, and 250×1.28=320250×1.28=320. Dividing by the new 320320 answers a different question.
Problem
A library had 640640 visitors on a sunny Saturday and 480480 on a rainy one, a drop of 160160. Divide by the original 640640. What percent decrease was this? Give the number only.
Show a hint
  • First find the drop, then ask what fraction of the ORIGINAL it is. The drop is 640−480=160640−480=160, and the original is 640640, so the percent change is 160640640160​ written as a percent.
  • Simplify 160640640160​. Both top and bottom share a factor of 160160, so it becomes 1441​, and 14=25%41​=25%. Resist the urge to divide by 480480. The original count is the whole here.
Show the full solution
The drop is 640−480=160640−480=160 visitors, and a percent change divides by the original 640640. 640−480640=160640=14=0.25=25%640640−480​=640160​=41​=0.25=25% So the answer is 2525​. Dividing by 480480 instead gives about 33%33%, which answers how much the count would have to grow to climb back to 640640.
Problem
A bamboo shoot grew from 1414 cm to 3535 cm, a change of 2121 cm. Since 21>1421>14, the percent will sail past 100%100%. What percent increase was this? Give the number only.
Show a hint
  • The change is 35−14=2135−14=21 centimeters. For a percent change you always divide by the ORIGINAL amount, the 1414 centimeters it started at, not the 3535 it ended at.
  • Compute 21141421​ and turn it into a percent. Since 2121 is more than 1414, this fraction is bigger than 11, so the percent lands above 100%100%.
Show the full solution
The change is 35−14=2135−14=21 centimeters, and a percent change divides by the original 1414. 35−1414=2114=32=1.51435−14​=1421​=23​=1.5 That is 150%150%, so the increase is 150150​. A plain doubling to 2828 would be a 100%100% increase, and this went past double, so the percent lands above 100100.
Key idea
Percent change == change ÷÷ original. Subtract to find the change, new minus old. Divide the change by the original amount and write the result as a percent. The original goes in the denominator, never the new amount. It is an increase when the number grew and a decrease when it shrank. Doubling adds one extra copy, so it is a 100%100% increase, not 200%200%. A rise has no limit, but a decrease cannot pass 100%100%, since once everything is gone there is nothing left to remove.
Fun fact
"Percentage points" and "percent change" differ. A rate rising from 5%5% to 7%7% is 22 percentage points (subtraction) but a 40%40% increase (2÷52÷5). Headlines often swap them.
Problem
After a 20%20% increase, a shelf holds 738 books. To recover last year's count, divide by 1.201.20, not subtract 20%20% of 738. How many books were there before?
Show a hint
  • The tempting wrong path is 738−20%738−20% of 738=590.4738=590.4, which is not even a whole number of books. The 20%20% growth was a slice of last year's count, not of this year's. So the right question is what number, when grown by 20%20%, lands on 738738.
  • A 20%20% increase multiplies the original by 1.201.20, so 1.20×original=7381.20×original=738. To undo a multiplication, divide. Compute 738÷1.20738÷1.20.
Show the full solution
A 20%20% increase multiplies by 1.201.20, so 1.20×original=7381.20×original=738. Undo the multiplication by dividing, 738÷1.20=615738÷1.20=615. Check it forward, 1.20×615=7381.20×615=738. Last year the shelf held 615615​ books. Subtracting 20%20% of 738738 gives 590.4590.4, too low, because the 20%20% was a slice of last year's smaller count.
Problem
A ferry pass now costs $510$510 after a 15%15% fare cut. A 15%15% decrease multiplied the old price by 0.850.85. What was the original season pass price in dollars?
Show a hint
  • A 15%15% decrease keeps 100%−15%=85%100%−15%=85% of the original, so it multiplies the old price by 0.850.85 to give 510510. The 510510 is the new amount, not the original.
  • Since original×0.85=510original×0.85=510, undo the multiplier by dividing. Compute 510÷0.85510÷0.85. Adding 15%15% of 510510 back on is the wrong move, because that 15%15% would be a slice of the smaller current price, not of the original.
Show the full solution
A 15%15% cut leaves 100%−15%=85%100%−15%=85%, so original×0.85=510original×0.85=510. Divide by the multiplier to recover the old price. original=5100.85=600original=0.85510​=600 The season pass was 600600​ dollars. Adding 15%15% of 510510 back gives 586.50586.50, short of the mark, since 15%15% of the smaller current price is smaller.
Problem
A bee colony of 200200 grew by 30%30% one week, then shrank by 30%30% the next. Many guess it returns to 200200. It does not. How many workers are in the colony at the end?
Show a hint
  • Do the two weeks in order, one change at a time. A 30%30% increase multiplies by 1.301.30, so the boosted colony is 200×1.30200×1.30. Whatever that comes to is the new starting size for week two.
  • For week two, a 30%30% decrease multiplies by 0.700.70. The catch is that the 30%30% is taken off the bigger boosted number, not off the original 200200, so it removes more bees than the increase added.
Show the full solution
A 30%30% rise multiplies by 1.301.30 and a 30%30% fall by 0.700.70. Week one gives 200×1.30=260200×1.30=260 workers, and week two gives 260×0.70=182260×0.70=182. The colony ends at 182182​ workers. Chained, 1.30×0.70=0.911.30×0.70=0.91, under 11, because the drop came off the larger 260260 and removed more than the rise added.
Key idea
Division undoes a percent change. The new amount is the original times the multiplier, so original == new ÷÷ multiplier. After a 20%20% rise, divide by 1.201.20 to recover the original. Do not subtract the same percent from the new amount. That percent came from the smaller original, so subtracting it now takes off too much. Sequential changes multiply rather than add, since each change acts on a different amount. So a p%p% rise then a p%p% fall never returns you to the start, since (1+p100) ⁣(1−p100)(1+100p​)(1−100p​) is always less than 11.

Every percent change in this lesson is a single multiplier. It is above 11 for an increase and below 11 for a decrease. To apply several changes in a row, multiply their multipliers together.

Problem
A recycling program collects 5,0005,000 kg in Q1 and expects each later quarter to grow by 10%10%. Each quarter multiplies by 1.101.10. How many kilograms are expected in Q4 (three quarters later)?
Show a hint
  • A 10%10% increase multiplies the amount by 1.101.10. One quarter later it is 5,000×1.105,000×1.10. Each new quarter multiplies the previous quarter's amount by 1.101.10 again.
  • Three quarters later means three multipliers stacked, so compute 5,000×1.10×1.10×1.105,000×1.10×1.10×1.10. Take it one step at a time, 5,0005,000 to 5,5005,500 to 6,0506,050, then once more.
Show the full solution
Each quarter multiplies by 1+10100=1.101+10010​=1.10, and three quarters later means three of those multipliers. 5,000×1.103=5,000×1.331=6,6555,000×1.103=5,000×1.331=6,655 Q4 is expected to bring 66556655​ kilograms. Step by step that is 5,5005,500, then 6,0506,050, then 6,6556,655, with the jumps growing because each 10%10% comes off a bigger amount.
Problem
An art class had 400400 students. Enrollment rose 50%50% for summer, then fell 40%40% from that summer peak. A 50%50% rise and a 40%40% fall do not cancel. What is the fall enrollment?
Show a hint
  • Do it in two steps, one change at a time. A 50%50% increase multiplies by 1.501.50, so the summer peak is 400×1.50400×1.50. Whatever that comes to, the fall drop of 40%40% is measured off that peak, not off the original 400400.
  • A 40%40% decrease multiplies by 1−0.40=0.601−0.40=0.60, so multiply the summer peak by 0.600.60. If you like, chain the multipliers first, 1.50×0.60=0.901.50×0.60=0.90, which already tells you the fall figure lands at 90%90% of the original, not back at 100%100%.
Show the full solution
A 50%50% rise multiplies by 1.501.50, so the summer peak is 400×1.50=600400×1.50=600. A 40%40% fall multiplies by 0.600.60, so the fall count is 600×0.60=360600×0.60=360. Enrollment is 360360​. The two changes do not cancel, since 1.50×0.60=0.901.50×0.60=0.90. The rise was figured on 400400 but the fall on the larger 600600.

Practice these ideas

Practice
A bakery sold 8080 loaves on Tuesday and 15%15% more on Wednesday. How many loaves did the bakery sell on Wednesday?
Show the solution
A 15%15% increase multiplies by 1+15100=1.151+10015​=1.15, so Wednesday's total is 80×1.15=92.80×1.15=92. The bakery sold 9292​ loaves. The long way matches, since 0.15×80=120.15×80=12 and 80+12=9280+12=92.
Practice
A winter jacket priced at $250$250 is marked 30%30% off. What is the sale price in dollars?
Show the solution
A 30%30% decrease keeps 70%70% of the price, so the multiplier is 1−0.30=0.701−0.30=0.70. Apply it to the original price. 250×0.70=175250×0.70=175 The sale price is 175175​ dollars.
Practice
A stadium that held 600600 fans expanded its seating by 45%45%. How many seats are there now?
Show the solution
A 45%45% increase makes the new seating 100%+45%=145%100%+45%=145% of the old, a multiplier of 1.451.45. 600×1.45=870600×1.45=870 The stadium now holds 870870​ seats.
Practice
A bamboo shoot rose from 4040 cm to 5454 cm, a change of 1414 cm. Divide by the original. What percent increase is this? Give the number only.
Show the solution
The change is 54−40=1454−40=14 centimeters, and a percent change divides by the original 4040. That gives 1440=0.354014​=0.35, or 35%35%, so the increase is 3535​. Forward check, 40×1.35=5440×1.35=54.
Practice
A reservoir dropped from 900900 to 720720 megalitres, a fall of 180180. What percent decrease is this? Give the number only.
Show the solution
The drop is 900−720=180900−720=180 megaliters, and a percent change divides by the original 900900. 180900=15=0.20900180​=51​=0.20 That is a 20%20% decrease, so the answer is 2020​. The multiplier agrees, since 720900=0.80900720​=0.80 means the reservoir kept 80%80% of its water.
Practice
A startup grew from 2525 customers to 7575, a jump of 5050. Since 50>2550>25, the percent lands above 100%100%. What percent increase is this? Give the number only.
Show the solution
The change is 75−25=5075−25=50 customers, and a percent increase divides by the original 2525. That gives 5025=22550​=2, which as a percent is 200%200%, so the answer is 200200​. The new count is 33 times the old, and a multiplier of 33 is 1+21+2, the original 100%100% plus a 200%200% increase on top.
Practice
After a 25%25% increase, a road bike sells for $500$500. The 25%25% was on the OLD price. What was the original price in dollars?
Show the solution
A 25%25% increase multiplies by 1+25100=1.251+10025​=1.25, so 1.25×original=5001.25×original=500. Divide to undo it. original=5001.25=400original=1.25500​=400 The original price was 400400​ dollars. Subtracting 25%25% of 500500 would give 375375, which is wrong because the 25%25% was taken on the smaller original.
Practice
After a 20%20% decrease, a sofa sells for $480$480. The multiplier was 0.800.80. What was the original price in dollars?
Show the solution
A 20%20% decrease keeps 100%−20%=80%100%−20%=80%, so original×0.80=480original×0.80=480. Divide by the multiplier instead of adding 20%20% back. original=4800.80=600original=0.80480​=600 The original price was 600600​ dollars. Forward check, 600×0.80=480600×0.80=480.
Practice
A vlogger started with 200200 subscribers, gained 40%40%, then lost 25%25% of that new total. How many subscribers does the channel have after both months?
Show the solution
A 40%40% gain multiplies by 1.401.40 and a 25%25% loss by 0.750.75. Month one gives 200×1.40=280200×1.40=280 subscribers, and month two gives 280×0.75=210280×0.75=210. The final count is 210210​. It does not land back at 200200, because the 25%25% drop came off the larger 280280.
Practice
A koi pond holds 2,0002,000 liters and gains 20%20% each day. How many liters does the pond hold after three full days of growth?
Show the solution
A 20%20% increase multiplies by 1.201.20, and three days means three of those multipliers. 2,000×1.203=3,4562,000×1.203=3,456 The pond holds 34563456​ liters. Day by day that is 2,4002,400, then 2,8802,880, then 3,4563,456.
Practice
A factory used 1,5001,500 kWh last month and cut usage by 8%8% this month. How many kWh did the factory use this month?
Show the solution
An 8%8% decrease leaves 100%−8%=92%100%−8%=92% of the original, so the multiplier is 0.920.92. Multiply the original amount by it. 1,500×0.92=1,3801,500×0.92=1,380 So this month the factory used 13801380​ kilowatt-hours.
Practice
A scout troop grew from 120120 to 156156 members, a change of 3636. Divide by the original. What percent increase is this? Give the number only.
Show the solution
The change is 156−120=36156−120=36 members, and a percent change divides by the original 120120. 36120=0.3012036​=0.30 That is a 30%30% increase, so the answer is 3030​. Forward check, 120×1.30=156120×1.30=156.
Practice
A camping tent is marked down 40%40% and now sells for $90$90. The sale price is 60%60% of the original. What was the original price in dollars?
Show the solution
A 40%40% markdown leaves 1−0.40=0.601−0.40=0.60 of the price, so 0.60×original=900.60×original=90. Divide to undo the multiplier, 90÷0.60=15090÷0.60=150. The original price was 150150​ dollars. Check it forward, 150−0.40×150=150−60=90150−0.40×150=150−60=90.
Practice
A club had $500$500. A fundraiser raised it by 20%20%, then supply costs cut it by 20%20%. How many dollars are left in the fund?
Show the solution
The fundraiser multiplies by 1+0.20=1.201+0.20=1.20 and the supply costs by 1−0.20=0.801−0.20=0.80. 500×1.20×0.80=600×0.80=480500×1.20×0.80=600×0.80=480 The fund has 480480​ dollars left. It lands below 500500 because the 20%20% drop was taken from the larger 600600, so it removed more than was added.
